stem: Which sentence from the selection best states the author’s main objective in raising Atticus?

options.label: F
options.text: I know many who tell me that by teaching their dog tricks they worked on their relationship together.

options.label: G
options.text: The things I wanted him to learn were basic things that made going through life safe and easy.

options.label: H
options.text: Instead he just looked at them, not even bothering to cock his head.

options.label: J
options.text: I never saw the point in teaching Atticus tricks.

visual_elements: Answer choices F, G, H, and J with italicized text
